name: Omi-Hachiman Merchant Canal
description: A romantic Edo-period merchant canal lined with white-walled storehouses, stone moats, and traditional hand-rowed Suigo boat tours.
notes: Suigo boat tours offer scenic cruises through lakeside reed beds.
notesJa: 【見どころ】白壁の土蔵や石垣が残る八幡堀と、水郷めぐりのどんこ船遊覧が情趣溢れる城下町です。
reservation: Boat tours available on site or online
reservationJa: 【予約】水郷めぐり船は当日受付可能です。
parkingJa: 【駐車場】八幡堀周辺有料駐車場あり。
